question: Should OpenClaw retire these 37 shipped bundled skills now, and should ClawHub-only official packages such as Sherpa receive bare-ID resolution and official trust treatment under this contract?
rationale: The branch changes a shipped starter-set contract, upgrade behavior, and official package trust boundary; tests cannot determine whether maintainers intend those product and security policies.

options.title: Require migration, then land
options.body: Approve the direction only after every removed skill is published and installable, existing references have a tested doctor migration or equivalent recovery, and the current dependency head is authorized.

options.title: Split Sherpa from retirement
options.body: Land the bounded Sherpa external-plugin and installer work separately while keeping the existing bundled skills until a dedicated deprecation plan is ready.

options.title: Keep the current bundle
options.body: Close or park the remaining branch and retain the shipped starter set while optional skill distribution continues through existing ClawHub paths.

recommendation.title: Require migration, then land
recommendation.body: Approve the direction only after every removed skill is published and installable, existing references have a tested doctor migration or equivalent recovery, and the current dependency head is authorized.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent split work and have already framed this branch as the remaining bundled-skill and Sherpa packaging decision surface.
